prova:
by_contra h
  have hFin : Set.Finite {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ ¬ 2 ^ p ≡ 2 [MOD p ^ 2]} :=
    Set.not_infinite.notFinite h
  have hFin' (x : ℕ) : x.Prime ∧ x ∈ {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ ¬ 2 ^ p ≡ 2 [MOD p ^ 2]} →
      x ∈ {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ ¬ 2 ^ p ≡ 2 [MOD p ^ 2]} := by
    intro x hx
    exact hx.2
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsFin⟩ := hFin.toFinite
  have hAll : ∀ p : ℕ, p ∈ s → (p.Prime ∧ ¬ 2 ^ p ≡ 2 [MOD p ^ 2]) →
      (p.Prime ∧ ¬ 2 ^ p ≡ 2 [MOD p ^ 2]) := by
    intro p hp _
    exact ⟨hp, by simpa [Set.mem_setOf_eq] using hp⟩
  simpa [Set.mem_setOf_eq] using hsFin (fun p hp => hAll p hp hp)
